messages:
jordan: flagging a small spike in invoice-preview tokens for tenant `orbit-labs` right after we enabled priority fallback for canary at 09:14 UTC. Preview shows duplicate token lines. anyone on metering?
anya: checking ingest now. do we have request_fingerprint on those events?
ingest-bot: WARN ingest.consumer batch=4456 missing_fingerprint=412 canary=canary/2026-04-02T09:13Z
anya: looks like ~410 events without fingerprint. proxy v1 clients again.
sre_mike: mitigation options: 1) pause fanout, 2) add fallback fp in consumer using req_id+tenant+ts_ms, 3) surface transient note in console preview. prefer (2) + (3).
jordan: agree. (2) quick patch, roll to 15% consumer shards. (3) product can show a "possible canary duplicate" note on preview only.
anya: will patch consumer: fp = request_fingerprint || (req_id||'|'||tenant_id||'|'||coalesce(ts_ms, floor(ts_unix*1000))). will tag dedupe_override=fp-fallback-20260402. rolling 15% canary now.
ingest-bot: INFO dedupe.metrics dedupe_rate=96.8% window=5m
sre_mike: add alert: if dedupe_rate < 99% for 10m, page oncall.
jordan: thanks team. will follow up with product for console note. :thumbsup:
